'''SC Preußen Münster''' ([[English language|English]]: ''Prussia Münster'') is a German sports club based in [[Münster]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]] which is mostly recognised for its [[Association football|football]] section. The football team currently plays in the [[3. Liga]] which is the third tier in German football. Preußen Münster also fields teams in [[tennis]], [[Sport of athletics|athletics]], [[futsal]], [[handball]], [[fistball]], [[darts]] and [[esports]]."}}
